body.name: \widehat\chi_n
body.type: atlas chart label or fallback label
body.def: Among labels that \(\mathscr A\) certifies as rigid charts and that satisfy \(d_{\chi}(\widehat\zeta_n)\le t_n\) and \(\eta_{\chi}(\widehat\zeta_n)\ge\varepsilon/2\), choose the lexicographically first; if this set is empty, set \(\widehat\chi_n=\bot\).
